new_structural_fact: the right-edge column x is occupied by THREE classes, not two: (1) the down-lane columns (In2), (2) the up-lane columns/vias (In2), and (3) J2's pad grid (F.Cu, two columns x approx 132.65 / 135.0 across the whole landing y-band). Under the existing escape architecture the set of column x satisfying 'corner clear (x <= 137.6537)' AND 'clear of all three' is EMPTY in this window's measurement. This is the concrete origin of #K2-355 sec.2.3 (B) 're-plan the escape architecture' - an architecture problem, not a coordinate problem.
capability_gap_C29: the R915 band analyser covers In2 only (its own stated limit). It yields a NECESSARY condition, not a sufficient one; this window judged FREE from it while the real DRC judged FAIL. Closure: fold F.Cu pads/tracks and In5 into the occupancy model, or mandate DRC-in-the-loop in planning; regression = the next planning window's DRC verdict agrees with its planning verdict.
